name: ui8kit
description: ui8kit monorepo (UI8Kit 3 primitives in packages/kit via the ui8kit CLI): packages/compose-gen (specs, schemas, fixtures and the generator of the composition layer), packages/kit-compose (compositions over the v3 primitives, organisms for Svelte, React, Vue, Solid, Go templ, Twig, Jinja2 and Latte), packages/skins, one shared app package, and one host app per JS runtime that serves every screen spec by name. Bun workspaces.

scripts.build: bun packages/compose-gen/check.ts --write --no-check && bun packages/kit-compose/src/build.ts && bun packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts && bun packages/kit-compose/src/server-organisms.ts && bun packages/kit-compose/src/hosts.ts
scripts.check: node packages/tooling/bin/xgen-exit-guard.mjs && node packages/tooling/bin/kit-check.mjs && bun run compose:check && bun run gates:source && bun packages/skins/skins.ts build --check && bun packages/compose-gen/schema/src/codex-blocks.ts --check && bun packages/tooling/rules/rules.ts --gate
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run codex:validate && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.build:hosts: bun run --cwd apps/host-svelte build && bun run --cwd apps/host-react build && bun run --cwd apps/host-vue build && bun run --cwd apps/host-solid build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter "@ui8kit/app-shared" --filter "@codegen-x/*-compose" --filter "host-*" --filter "discovery" --filter "@ui8kit/panorama" --filter "@ui8kit/taste-data" --filter "@ui8kit/taste-screens" --filter "magazine" --parallel check && bun run --cwd packages/kit-compose typecheck
scripts.check:all: bun run build && bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run build:hosts && bun run test && bun run lint:px && bun run e2e
scripts.compose:check: bun packages/compose-gen/check.ts && bun packages/kit-compose/src/build.ts --check && bun packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts --check && bun packages/kit-compose/src/server-organisms.ts --check && bun packages/kit-compose/src/hosts.ts --check
scripts.gates:source: node packages/ui-gates/bin/ui-gates.mjs source packages/kit-compose/react packages/kit-compose/svelte packages/kit-compose/vue packages/kit-compose/solid packages/kit-compose/jinja2 packages/kit-compose/twig packages/kit-compose/latte packages/kit-compose/templ/src --allow-tag del
